faq.a: The S&P 500 is a stock market index that represents the performance of 500 of the largest publicly traded companies in the United States. It is widely considered a benchmark for the overall health of the US equity market and economy.

faq.q: How does US market performance affect Indian markets?
faq.a: US market performance can significantly influence Indian markets through FII (Foreign Institutional Investor) flows, global sentiment, and the performance of Indian companies with substantial US business exposure, particularly in the IT sector.

faq.q: Should I invest in US stocks directly?
faq.a: Direct investment in US stocks is possible for Indian residents, but it involves opening an international brokerage account, dealing with currency conversion, and understanding tax implications in both countries. Global feeder funds offer an easier route for many.
